evening.caption:
Which element is the best listener? 👂

In Chinese astrology your element comes from the day you were born. The yin elements are the receivers: Yin Water reads what isn't said, Yin Earth makes room for you, Yin Wood asks the question that helps. Yang Earth sneaks in as the calm mountain.
